title: FROALA Text Editor: Versions and their Upload Functionalities
text:
## FROALA Text Editor: Versions and their Upload Functionalities
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000019667
When creating a post, such as a blog article, there is a Froala Text Editor which allows modifying styles such as the font size, font colors, boldness, and more.
There are different text editor versions available that either restrict or allow for image upload and video embed.
These can be used and applied individually via the FORM MANAGER to the respective forms for the members' "ABOUT ME" section and all post types such as coupons, properties, classifieds, member articles, website blog articles, etc. This form field type is only supported for forms used within the Member Dashboard.
This provides the ability to control if members can add images and video embeds into the text editor input fields of posts and their "ABOUT ME" section.
The Froala Editor currently supports 38 languages , check which languages are supported: https://www.froala.com/wysiwyg-editor/languages.
The Froala Editor is going to use the language that is set in the Settings >> General Settings >> Localization tab >> Default Website Language.

## How To Enable Froala Editors
There are three built-in versions of the Froala Text Editor. You can add any of them to a form, and each one controls things like whether users can upload images or embed YouTube videos.
For details on where each editor is used throughout the site and what features they include, click the link below:
Everything About WYSIWYG Editors

## Available Text Editors
There are

## Froala Text Editor - Basic
No image upload, video embed, or source code editor
Basic text editor with limited options to edit font size, colors, styles, and create bullet checklists.
Bold
Italic
Underline
Font Size
Paragraph Format
Line Height
Text Color
Background Color
Clear Formatting
Ordered List
Unordered List
Insert Horizontal Line
Insert a Link
Upload images
Embed videos
Edit source code
Insert a table
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107845062/original/YITDhoVEJfg88n0oJoWzteOZ1imXMdoXHQ.png?1650387159 | alt: ]

## Froala Text Editor - Image Upload
Allows image upload, video embed, and source code editor
Allowed image formats: gif, jpeg, jpg, png, JPEG, JPG, SVG, PNG, webp, and pdf.
It includes the same styling options as the Basic Froala Editor AND it includes the ability to:
Upload images and GIFs
Embed YouTube videos
Insert a Table
Edit source code
Decrease or Increase Indent
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107845717/original/eEgp_DjiYVU-GEJbtBRnA4J1wTDIgc2ARw.png?1650387861 | alt: ]

## Froala Text Editor - Image Upload + Pre-Made Elements
Allows image upload, video embed, source code editor, and Pre-Made Elements
Allowed image formats: gif, jpeg, jpg, png, JPEG, SVG, JPG, PNG, webp, and pdf.
It enables the Pre-Made Elements module.
It includes the same styling options as the Basic Froala Editor AND it includes the ability to:
Upload images and GIFs
Embed YouTube videos
Edit source code
Insert and style web links
Choose the font type.
Add Pre-Made Elements
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107845547/original/Ax1ozk3T0r56iTIwaopmWvNxyj1lxRZELg.png?1650387681 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12171083676/original/aOv_jB6wlhUgvt70s-gTy41OcVkXq67fVA.png?1764115196 | alt: ]
Froala Text Editor - Access Media Manager

## FROALA EDITOR - ACCESS MEDIA MANAGER
Access Media Manager Froala Editor Screenshot
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107845427/original/lcNf30lpiFK5YzP6jkdYP7Pagy6dd6rKuQ.png?1650387539 | alt: ]
*  If members have access to the admin text editor, we strongly recommend setting up the Public Froala Editor rather than the Admin Froala Editor for security reasons (members would be able to see all images ever uploaded to the media manager).
It will also enable the Pre-Made Elements module:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12105087226/original/A5oVXeDn3ZbC8Q9gM4lBIECZld1jiagD-A.png?1644944119 | alt: ]

## Froala Editor Usage
To add any of the Froala Text Editor to a form, please follow these instructions:
1. Go to TOOLBOX >> FORM MANAGER >> SELECT A FORM TO EDIT If the form is not already active/customized, search the form by name and customize it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12103139907/original/UmPeMGgbsH2ETGBcZQkezMpsxZeHu6RWxQ.png?1641305836 | alt: ]
2. Select the Froala Editor from the drop-down:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12107844169/original/acChYhfUFy29iVfc8I_nLK1uASsSnsIdvQ.png?1650386196 | alt: ]
3. Click on "Save Changes"
* To confirm that the "Access Media Manager - Froala Text Editor" is working as expected, log in as the admin member and click on the "add image" icon. The FOLDER icon should be displayed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084184998/original/KjTpWCT__21BpidPG4xlKmIu6T-gIXqczg.png?1603816794 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089662682/original/wtgdDvX1rxVCW2EPVMrjQ8ap9_XfnMWB-g.png?1615055317 | alt: ]

## Include Images in Admin Blog Articles
To add an image inside the body of a blog article please follow these instructions:
1. Log in as a member that has the ability to write admin blog articles.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12089662693/original/_Zze8x6mo4_3DLs2CBiPk6n4-FkJIwZMBA.png?1615055434 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12103138132/original/JM41j1WJH3CL6wMM7SzAAXG5fxTJYLf4Iw.png?1641304125 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084185182/original/rK6rzZp8QOfN-0XzF2VLVCXKXFpkjxBsKg.png?1603816949 | alt: ]
Select the image and click on "Open".
The image will be uploaded in the article and it will display as follows:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084185394/original/KYRlc7LM3c-B0uG6c_4o_WfVB2k_b43rEg.png?1603817118 | alt: ]

## Additional Image Options
Align Image "left", "Center" or "right"
Add a link and style to it.
And much more!

## Embedding Youtube and Vimeo Videos
1. Log in as a member that has the ability to write admin blog articles.
2. Click on "Add New Blog"
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084185632/original/h6O5OdLq-04YAX6ueNXTptqTyA1bx1wAEA.png?1603817351 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084185748/original/Tprnm85eRKNcH9ySztN1S_AQr7wl9qc7MQ.png?1603817471 | alt: ]
5. Click on "Insert"
6. The video will now display in the blog article:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12084185826/original/WaY8dea2wIKyGm_6wF8axvZu07SaCCjN2Q.png?1603817549 | alt: ]

## Adding Embedly to a Froala Editor
There is an option to enable an Embedly button on any of the Froala Editors.
List of the Embedly providers: https://embed.ly/providers
In order to enable this option, please go to Settings >> Advanced Settings >> Enable Embedly in Frontend Froala Editors.
It will include Embedly embeddable content in all of the Froala Editors of each type used throughout the website.
They can be selected here:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12115146807/original/06YxpSaHj0bDmfHV6RQWKPu7IQ9y_VSp8w.png?1664296990 | alt: ]
The Embedly button will show up on the Froala Editor selected above:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12115146933/original/0mWmn7Il-M7CTG554TF3t-lw3lLdd-jviA.png?1664297105 | alt: ]

## Remove HTML Attributes
There is an advanced setting that allows removing the HTML attributes when pasting text from another source into the Froala:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12126978550/original/JbhNuv_GRoOo4cfgTN1RJ0_gerPcYxQr7Q.png?1686846623 | alt: ]
Note: This will apply to all Froalas including the ones on the admin.

## Froala Markdown
Markdown is an easy-to-use markup language that is used with plain text to add formatting elements (headings, bulleted lists, URLs) to plain text without the use of a formal text editor or the use of HTML tags.
https://www.markdownguide.org/
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168284293/original/Z0CCB-KakYn32wxbhBWKE4bvx-H9vB8o-Q.jpeg?1759248639 | alt: ]
This can be enabled for the following individual Froala classes:
Froala Text Editor - Admin
Froala Text Editor - Basic
Froala Text Editor - Image Upload
Froala Text Editor - Image Upload + Pre-Made Elements
Froala Text Editor - Access Media Manager
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12168002279/original/mD1XV3xr6nwLn5wm1kx7DN2MM1Zz8Er4wA.png?1758739890 | alt: ]
